video_title: Joel Embiid is better than Giannis Antetokounmpo 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo when both are healthy
quotes.excerpt: If Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo are healthy, who are you taking?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo are healthy, who are you taking? Top three?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I think he is top five for me. He is not top three. He is not better than Nikola Jokic, he is not better than Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and he is not better than Luka Doncic for me.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I would take Luka Doncic, personally.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You would take Luka Doncic over Joel Embiid healthy?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I would take Luka Doncic, personally.

quotes.excerpt: If Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo are healthy, who are you taking?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating what Giannis Antetokounmpo can do that Joel Embiid cannot
quotes.excerpt: What can Giannis Antetokounmpo do that Joel Embiid can't?
quotes.quote: What can Giannis Antetokounmpo do that Joel Embiid can't? Stay healthy. See, that's what I'm talking about. We said healthy. If they're both healthy, who is better?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Questioning if Giannis Antetokounmpo is better than Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: You would take Giannis Antetokounmpo over Joel Embiid healthy?
quotes.quote: You would take Giannis Antetokounmpo over Joel Embiid healthy? I'm asking you a question. Would you take Giannis Antetokounmpo over Joel Embiid healthy?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the offensive capabilities of Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I can do more with Joel Embiid than I can do with Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: I can do more with Joel Embiid than I can do with Giannis Antetokounmpo. Ability to shoot changes a lot too. That's all I'm saying. That's why I said it's not a hard question because he can genuinely shoot. Are you taking Giannis Antetokounmpo over Joel Embiid?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the shooting abilities of Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: One is the best shooter we've ever seen, but one can shoot way better than Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: One is the best shooter we've ever seen, but one can shoot way better than Giannis Antetokounmpo. Giannis Antetokounmpo can't shoot.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Joel Embiid and Giannis Antetokounmpo debate is always close
quotes.excerpt: I think it's going to always be a close conversation because everyone thinks of Joel Embiid.
quotes.quote: I think it's going to always be a close conversation because everyone thinks of Joel Embiid. The first thing you think of is, this motherfucker just can't stay healthy. My question is, if they're both healthy, it's not close. If Joel Embiid never got hurt, I don't think they're in the same conversation.
